parsed.rationale: All three records — `SheetDraggingKey` in `WXUI/OverlaySheet.swift`, `ThemePickerActiveKey` in `Wallpaper/ThemePickerState.swift`, and `UITestingModeKey` in `Wallpaper/ThemePickerState.swift` — are `type-alias-object` kinds with empty `fields_or_signature` lists. The structural signal is that they share the same shape (a zero-field type alias, likely SwiftUI `EnvironmentKey` witness types), but each encodes a distinct, unrelated domain concept: sheet-dragging state, theme-picker activation state, and UI-testing mode. Merging or extracting them would conflate unrelated environment keys purely on structural coincidence, not semantic relatedness. The packages `WXUI` and `Wallpaper` serve different concerns, and there is no evidence of an upstream shared package that would be the right home for all three.
